title: Two Men Rode a Balloon to 37,000 Feet. One Blacked Out

scenes.text: In 1862, two men flew a balloon to 37,000 feet. One passed out.
That is higher than Mount Everest, in an open basket, with no oxygen.
The scientist James Glaisher could not read his instruments. Then he lost consciousness.
The pilot's hands froze, so he pulled the valve rope with his teeth.
The balloon dropped, and both men landed alive.
They went higher than anyone had ever been.

description:
In September 1862 two British aeronauts flew to about 37,000 feet in an open balloon basket.
James Glaisher lost consciousness, and pilot Henry Coxwell pulled the valve rope with his teeth after his hands stopped working.
Could you have gone up with them?
first_comment: Commercial jets cruise at about this height today, inside a sealed cabin. Would you have gone up in that basket?
